question: A rainbow is observed due to refraction of the sunlight through rain drops. This implies that:

options.text: refractive index of rain drop is 1
rain drops are not spherical in shape

solution:
The correct answer is** **__**sunlight is polychromatic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The** **polychromatic light **​

 
 
• The polychromatic light source is a **source that gives light of several wavelengths (hence several colors)**. White light is polychromatic because it is a combination of different wavelengths (violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, and red).
 
• ** ****Rainbow** is caused due to the **dispersion of sunlight** from water drops.
 
• Some parts of the **sunlight** fall on water drops and then enter the **water drops**. Now the color components of the sunlight are **dispersed** and forming a rainbow.
 
• So when the **sunlight** falls on the water drop it enters the water drop due to the refraction phenomenon. So here the water drop acts as a prism. So when the white light passes through this prism, the white light is dispersed into its different component colors-**orange, red, yellow, green, blue, and violet.** This is known as the **dispersion phenomenon.** This phenomenon is caused by the change in the speed of light rays of different wavelengths.
 
• So it can say a **rainbow** is formed due to the dispersion of sunlight from water droplets and the refraction of sunlight into the water droplets.
